snippet.title: This Is SS14 (Space Station 14 Gameplay Trailer)
snippet.description:
This is all live footage from the sever "Lizard". A ton of effort and passion went into making this trailer. I couldn't have made this video possible without the love of the Space Station 14 community. This game breathes through the community, and I can't thank everyone enough. I hope this trailer brings in new players, and encourages old ones. Enjoy. 

Play Space Station 14 Here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1255460/Space_Station_14/
Like and Subscribe for more content.
